reasons.text: The claimed purchase date of 2015-12-19 is before the program's sale window (2016-01-01 to 2019-12-31), so the purchase is not eligible for a refund.
The label photo is legible and shows model 93550, which is a recalled model, so the product itself is confirmed as recalled.
The retailer, ALDI, is on the list of sold-at retailers, and no duplicate claims were found.
The destruction photo does not show the required unplugged power cord cut; the cord appears intact. This is an additional deficiency, though the purchase-window denial alone decides the claim.
